_metadata.description: Shared evaluator fixture for v6.0 profile_gate. Python (scripts/profile_gate_evaluator.py) and Dart (Flutter alert-rendering layer) MUST both produce the same fires/severity output for every case below. Drift between the two implementations is the failure this fixture catches.

test_cases.name: condition_gate_diabetes_match
test_cases.description: Diabetic user matches condition gate

test_cases.name: condition_gate_diabetes_no_match
test_cases.description: Hypertensive user (no diabetes) does NOT match diabetes gate

test_cases.name: profile_flag_gate_pregnant_match
test_cases.description: Pregnant user matches pregnancy gate

test_cases.name: profile_flag_gate_ttc_does_not_fire_pregnancy_only_rule
test_cases.description: TTC user does NOT match a pregnancy-only gate (TTC is a separate flag)

test_cases.name: profile_flag_gate_pregnancy_lactation_union_pregnant_user
test_cases.description: Pregnancy/lactation union gate fires for pregnant user

test_cases.name: profile_flag_gate_pregnancy_lactation_union_breastfeeding_user
test_cases.description: Pregnancy/lactation union gate fires for breastfeeding user

test_cases.name: drug_class_gate_anticoagulant_match
test_cases.description: Patient on anticoagulant matches anticoagulants gate

test_cases.name: combination_gate_pregnant_and_nsaids_match
test_cases.description: Pregnant user with a stack medication resolved to NSAIDs matches the standalone medication profile-gate predicate.

test_cases.name: combination_gate_kidney_disease_and_nsaids_match
test_cases.description: Kidney disease profile with a stack medication resolved to NSAIDs matches the standalone medication profile-gate predicate.

test_cases.name: combination_gate_diabetes_and_hypoglycemics_both_match
test_cases.description: Diabetic on insulin matches combination gate (AND across keys). Post-v6.1.0 hypoglycemics split: the gate fans out to all three sub-tiers so any hypoglycemic-class medication satisfies the requirement — preserves the pre-split 'any hypoglycemic alerts diabetes condition' semantic. User on high-risk insulin matches.

test_cases.name: combination_gate_diabetes_only_does_not_match
test_cases.description: Diabetic NOT on any hypoglycemic-class medication — combination gate requires BOTH; only diabetes is met. Gate fans out to all three v6.1.0 sub-tiers (same as the matching case above); user has no drug class so the drug_classes_any requirement is unmet.

test_cases.name: excludes_product_form_topical_aloe_suppressed

test_cases.name: excludes_product_form_oral_aloe_fires
test_cases.description: Pregnant user using oral aloe — pregnancy gate fires (topical_only excluded does NOT match capsule)

test_cases.name: excludes_nutrient_form_beta_carotene_suppressed

test_cases.name: excludes_nutrient_form_retinol_fires
test_cases.description: Pregnant user using retinol — vitamin A pregnancy gate fires (beta_carotene excluded does NOT match retinol)

test_cases.name: dose_block_threshold_not_met_uses_lower_severity
